hero.body: Some feelings stay with us. Here, they have room to glow.

items.full: You are still here. Let that be enough for tonight.
The younger you never needed to grow in a hurry.
Even in the quiet, something in you keeps singing.
For a moment, let the sea hold what your heart cannot.
After everything, your tenderness is still here.
You can begin again without making a sound.
Every piece of you belongs here, even the ones still finding their place.
